claims: C1 the example illustrates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule
C2 the GOOD response avoids making a personal inference from the user's attire
C3 the BAD response makes a presumptuous and potentially offensive inference based on the user's outfit
C4 such an inference is forbidden by the rule

concepts.name: no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule
concepts.gloss: I is a personal observation or comment about the user that was not solicited
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's example text refers to the rule without defining it

concepts.name: user_wearing_traditional_attire
concepts.gloss: U is a user whose clothing is traditional attire, as shown in the example's video

concepts.name: user_asks_recipe_ideas
concepts.gloss: U is a user who has asked for dinner recipe suggestions

concepts.name: inference_based_on_outfit
concepts.gloss: I is an inference the assistant makes about U's culture or preferences based on U's outfit

asserts.read_back: making a personal inference % about the user's culture based on their outfit is forbidden because it is an unprompted personal comment

closure.reason: the example marks the outfit-based inference as BAD and presumptuous, so the silence about other personal inferences is not a permission; the rule's whole point is to refrain from unsolicited personal comments
